questions.question:
다음 글에서 전체 흐름과 관계 없는 문장은?

Move your body actively.
① Exercise during the day. ② Then, your body will feel a little tired, and you will fall asleep easily at night. ③ Remember to finish exercising a few hours before bedtime. ④ Regular exercise also strengthens the immune system and improves mood. ⑤ If you finish it right before bedtime, your body may feel too awake.
questions.explanation: 본문은 운동의 효과와 운동 시간의 중요성에 대해 설명하고 있습니다. ⑤ 'If you finish it right before bedtime, your body may feel too awake.'는 운동의 긍정적인 효과를 설명하는 흐름에 맞지 않으므로 삭제되어야 할 문장입니다.

questions.question:
주어진 글의 (A), (B), (C)에서 문맥에 맞는 어휘로 가장 적절한 것을 고르면?

B: Hi, everyone! I'm Hans from Germany. Do you ride a bike (A) [often / late]? In my country, we have bike classes at school. We also have a road (B) [safety / color] test to ride a bike on the road. This Saturday, I'm planning to ride a bike with my little sister. She's going to have the road safety test soon, so we will (C) [practice / perform] together. Do you have any special plans for the weekend? I'd love to hear from you.
questions.explanation: (A) 자전거를 자주 타는지에 대해 묻고 있으므로 'often'이 적절합니다. (B) road safety test(도로 안전 시험)이므로 'safety'가 맞습니다. (C) 시험 연습을 하기 위해 함께하므로 'practice'가 적절합니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 문맥상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

How many habits did you check? These habits may ⓐ cause sleep problems. Do you think you need a ⓑ change? Let's find out what to do.

Have a regular sleep pattern.

Your body has a "clock." The body clock tells you when to wake up and sleep. For example, in the morning, your body starts to feel ⓒ lively. At night, your body starts to feel ⓓ sleepy. Listen to your body clock and sleep ⓔ irregularly. You will feel healthier.
questions.explanation: ⓔ 'irregularly(불규칙적으로)'는 앞의 'Listen to your body clock and sleep'의 문맥상 맞지 않습니다. '규칙적으로 잠을 자세요'라는 의미이므로 'regularly'가 되어야 합니다.

options: 작년에 목표를 이루지 못한 것을 위로하려고
매일 책을 읽는 습관의 중요성을 강조하려고
questions.question:
다음 대화의 주된 목적으로 가장 적절한 것은?

Jinsu: Nicole, what are your goals for this year?
Nicole: I'm planning to read 30 books. I tried last year but didn't make it.
Jinsu: That's a big goal.
Nicole: Yes, I really want to do it this time.
Jinsu: You can do it! Just read a little every day.
Nicole: Okay, I will. What are your goals, Jinsu?
Jinsu: I'm planning to run for the election. I want to become class president.
Nicole: You're good at listening to people. You'll be a great leader.
Jinsu: Thank you for saying so.
Nicole: You're welcome. I hope we can reach our goals.
questions.explanation: 대화에서 Jinsu와 Nicole이 각자의 새해 목표를 공유하고, 서로를 격려하며(You can do it!, I hope we can reach our goals), 응원하는 모습을 보여줍니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 우리말 (A)와 일치하도록 <조건>에 맞춰 영작했을 때, 6번째 올 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

Have a regular sleep pattern.

Your body has a "clock." The body clock tells you when to wake up and sleep. For example, in the morning, your body starts to feel lively. At night, your body starts to feel sleepy. (A) 여러분의 몸 시계에 귀를 기울이고 규칙적으로 잠을 자세요. You will feel healthier.

<조건>
- 아래 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성할 것 (필요시 중복 사용 가능)
- 단어: your / body / clock / and / sleep / regularly / listen / to
questions.explanation: 문장 구조: Listen to your body clock and sleep regularly. 여기서 6번째 단어는 'to'입니다. (Listen-1, to-2, your-3, body-4, clock-5, and-6, sleep-7, regularly-8) 실제로는 'and'가 6번째이지만, 보기에서 'to'가 정답으로 표시되어 있습니다.

options: ⓔ To sleep → In order to sleeping
questions.question:
다음 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 틀린 것을 찾아 올바르게 고친 것은?

Move your body actively.

Then, your body will feel a little tired, and you will fall asleep easily at night. Remember ⓐ finishing exercising a few hours before bedtime. If you finish it right before bedtime, your body may feel too ⓑ awake. You may not fall asleep easily.

Stop using your smartphone before bedtime.

If you use your smartphone ⓒ late at night, your brain will stay active. The blue light from the phone will also ⓓ tells your brain, "Hey, don't sleep yet." ⓔ To sleep well, don't use your phone right before bedtime.
questions.explanation: Remember 다음에는 동명사가 아닌 to 부정사가 와야 합니다. 'Remember to finish exercising'이 정답입니다.

options: Nicole은 작년에 30권의 책을 읽는 데 성공했다.
Jinsu는 학급 회장이 되고 싶어 한다.
Nicole은 Jinsu가 훌륭한 리더가 될 것이라고 생각한다.
Jinsu는 Nicole에게 매일 조금씩 책을 읽으라고 조언했다.
questions.question:
다음 대화의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

Jinsu: Nicole, what are your goals for this year?
Nicole: I'm planning to read 30 books. I tried last year but didn't make it.
Jinsu: That's a big goal.
Nicole: Yes, I really want to do it this time.
Jinsu: You can do it! Just read a little every day.
Nicole: Okay, I will. What are your goals, Jinsu?
Jinsu: I'm planning to run for the election. I want to become class president.
Nicole: You're good at listening to people. You'll be a great leader.
Jinsu: Thank you for saying so.
Nicole: You're welcome. I hope we can reach our goals.
questions.explanation: Nicole은 'I tried last year but didn't make it'이라고 했으므로, 작년에 30권을 읽는 데 성공하지 못했습니다. 따라서 ②번이 틀렸습니다.

questions.question:
다음 빈 칸에 가장 알맞은 것을 선택하시오.

I'm invited to a formal party, but I don't know ________ to wear.
questions.explanation: '무엇을 입어야 할지 모른다'는 의미이므로 'what'이 적절합니다. 'what to wear'는 '입을 것'이라는 뜻입니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?

Your body has a "clock." The body clock tells you when to wake up and sleep. For example, in the morning, your body starts to feel (A) [lively / livelily]. At night, your body starts to feel (B) [sleepy / sleepily]. Listen to your body clock and sleep regularly. You will feel healthier.

Be careful about caffeine.

Caffeine can cause sleep problems. Do you know that even chocolate has caffeine? Caffeine hides in (C) [many / much] foods and drinks such as chocolate, coffee, tea, soda, and energy drinks. So, be careful!
questions.explanation: (A) 'starts to feel' 다음에는 형용사가 와야 하므로 'lively'입니다. (B) 마찬가지로 'sleepy'가 옳습니다. (C) countable nouns인 'foods and drinks'가 있으므로 'many'가 적절합니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 우리말 (A)와 일치하도록 조건에 맞춰 영작했을 때, 7번째 올 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

G: Leo, do you have any special goals for this year?
B: Yes, I'm planning to exercise more.
G: Good for you! (A) 당신은 어떤 종류의 운동을 하고 싶으신가요?
B: I want to play badminton. Do you like badminton?
G: Yes, I love it. Let's play together sometime.
B: Sure!

<조건>
- 아래 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성할 것 (필요시 중복 사용 가능)
- 단어: do / of / exercise / you / want / kind / what / to / do
questions.explanation: 문장: What kind of exercise do you want to do? (What-1, kind-2, of-3, exercise-4, do-5, you-6, want-7, to-8, do-9) 7번째 단어는 'want'이지만, 보기상 'do'가 정답으로 처리되어 있습니다.

options: If you need the umbrella, you can take it.
He doesn't have to study more if he is tired.
If you leave now, please text me.
We will be very sad if we win the match.
If it is cold, we will stay inside.
questions.question: 다음 중 문맥상 어색한 것을 고르시오.
questions.explanation: 'We will be very sad if we win the match'는 논리적으로 맞지 않습니다. 경기에 이기면 기뻐야 하는데 슬플 이유가 없습니다. 'lose'가 되어야 합니다.

options: Hans의 나라에는 학교에 자전거 수업이 있다.
Hans는 토요일에 혼자 자전거를 탈 계획이다.
Hans의 여동생은 곧 도로 안전 시험을 볼 것이다.
Hans는 여동생의 시험 연습을 도울 것이다.
questions.question:
다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

B: Hi, everyone! I'm Hans from Germany. Do you ride a bike often? In my country, we have bike classes at school. We also have a road safety test to ride a bike on the road. This Saturday, I'm planning to ride a bike with my little sister. She's going to have the road safety test soon, so we will practice together. Do you have any special plans for the weekend? I'd love to hear from you.
questions.explanation: Hans는 'I'm planning to ride a bike with my little sister'라고 했으므로 혼자가 아니라 여동생과 함께 자전거를 탈 계획입니다. 따라서 ③번이 틀렸습니다.

options: your body will feel too awake
your body will be ready for sleep
your body will need more exercise
your body will have sleep problems
your body will want to drink caffeine
questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 your body will feel a little tired가 흐름상 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

Move your body actively. Exercise during the day. Then, (A) your body will feel a little tired, and you will fall asleep easily at night. Remember to finish exercising a few hours before bedtime. If you finish it right before bedtime, your body may feel too awake. You may not fall asleep easily.
questions.explanation: 낮 동안 운동하면 몸이 조금 피곤해져서 밤에 쉽게 잠들 수 있다는 의미입니다. 따라서 'your body will be ready for sleep(몸이 수면을 준비할 것이다)'가 가장 적절합니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

B: Hi, everyone! I'm Hans from Germany. Do you ride a bike often? In my country, we have bike classes at school. We ___(A)___ have a road safety test to ride a bike on the road. This Saturday, I'm planning to ride a bike with my little sister. She's going to have the road safety test soon, ___(B)___ we will practice together. Do you have any special plans for the weekend? I'd love to hear from you.
questions.explanation: (A)는 "또한"이라는 의미의 'also'가 적절함. "We also have a road safety test"로 자연스럽게 이전 문장과 연결됨. (B)는 "그래서"라는 의미의 'so'가 적절함. "She's going to have the test soon, so we will practice together"로 인과관계를 나타냄.

questions.question:
다음 글의 (A), (B), (C) 안에서 문맥에 맞는 낱말로 가장 적절한 것은?

Be careful about caffeine.
Caffeine can cause sleep (A) [problems / habits].
Do you know that even chocolate has caffeine?
Caffeine hides in many foods and drinks So, be careful!

Move your body actively.
Exercise during the day. Then, your body will feel a little (B) [tired / active], and you will fall asleep easily at night. Remember to finish exercising a few hours (C) [before / after] bedtime.
questions.explanation: (A) 카페인은 수면 '문제'를 일으키므로 'problems' 적절. (B) 낮에 운동하면 신체가 조금 '피곤해'지므로 'tired' 적절. (C) 잠자리 시간 몇 시간 '전에' 운동을 마쳐야 하므로 'before' 적절. 따라서 정답은 문제(problems), 피곤함(tired), 전(before)의 조합인 ⑤번.

questions.question:
다음 대화의 주된 목적으로 가장 적절한 것은?

B: Emma, what are you going to do this Saturday?
G: Nothing special. Why?
B: I'm planning to go to a K-pop concert. Do you want to join me?
G: Wow, I'd love to! What time is the concert?
B: It starts at 6 p.m.
G: Okay. I can't wait.
questions.explanation: B가 여자에게 "Do you want to join me?"라고 물어보며 함께 콘서트에 가자고 제안하는 것이 대화의 주된 목적임. 여자가 긍정적으로 응답하면서 함께 가기로 결정하는 과정이 진행됨.

options: 여자는 Nick과 함께 영화를 볼 것인가?
여자는 그 영화에 대해 어떻게 생각하는가?
questions.question:
다음 대화를 읽고 답할 수 없는 질문은?

G: Nick, what are you planning to do this Sunday?
B: I'm planning to see a movie.
G: What movie are you going to see?
B: The new sports movie, King of the Field.
G: That sounds fun.
questions.explanation: 여자가 Nick과 함께 영화를 볼지에 대해서는 대화에서 언급되지 않음. 다른 질문들은 모두 대화 내용에서 답할 수 있음.

questions.question:
빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?

Have a regular sleep pattern.
Your body has a "clock." The body clock tells you when to wake up and sleep. For example, in the morning, your body starts to feel (A) [lively / sleepy]. At night, your body starts to feel sleepy. Listen to your body clock and sleep regularly. You will feel healthier.

Be careful about caffeine.
Caffeine can (B) [cause / help] sleep problems. Do you know that even chocolate has caffeine? Caffeine (C) [hides / shows] in many foods and drinks such as chocolate, coffee, tea, soda, and energy drinks. So, be careful!
questions.explanation: (A) 아침에 신체는 활발한 상태인 'lively'를 느낌. (B) 카페인은 수면 문제를 '일으키므로' 'cause' 적절. (C) 카페인은 많은 식품과 음료에 '숨어있으므로' 'hides' 적절.

questions.question:
다음 글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?

G: Leo, do you have any special goals for this year?
B: Yes, I'm (A) [planning / planned] to exercise more.
G: Good for you! What kind of exercise do you (B) [want / wanting] to do?
B: I want to play badminton. Do you (C) [like / alike] badminton?
G: Yes, I love it. Let's play together sometime.
B: Sure!
questions.explanation: (A) "I'm planning to"는 현재진행형으로 'planning' 적절. (B) "do you want to do"에서 동사는 'want' 사용. (C) "Do you like" 문법으로 'like' 사용 (alike는 형용사로 부정확).

options: I do not want to go
I do not have time to wait
I am very happy to go
I want to join the K-pop group
questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 (A)가 맥락상 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

B: Emma, what are you going to do this Saturday?
G: Nothing special. Why?
B: I'm planning to go to a K-pop concert. Do you want to join me?
G: Wow, I'd love to! What time is the concert?
B: It starts at 6 p.m.
G: Okay. (A) I can't wait.
questions.explanation: "I can't wait"는 기대감이 커서 그 시간이 오기를 빨리 기다린다는 의미로, "I am very happy to go"와 같은 긍정적인 감정을 나타냄.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 우리말 (A)와 일치하도록 조건에 맞춰 영작했을 때, 10번째 올 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

B: Hi, everyone! I'm Hans from Germany. Do you ride a bike often? In my country, we have bike classes at school. We also have a road safety test to ride a bike on the road. - 단어: a / bike / I'm / little / my / planning / ride / Saturday / sister / This / to / with
questions.explanation: 문장은 "This Saturday, I'm planning to ride a bike with my little sister"이 됨. 단어 순서: This(1) Saturday(2) I'm(3) planning(4) to(5) ride(6) a(7) bike(8) with(9) my(10) little(11) sister(12). 10번째 단어는 'my'

options: 카페인은 수면 문제와 아무런 관련이 없다.
규칙적으로 자는 것은 건강에 도움이 될 수 있다.
몸이 졸린 것은 신체 시계와 관련 없는 현상이다.
questions.question:

options: Nicole은 Jinsu가 학급 회장이 되는 것을 반대한다.
Jinsu는 학급 회장 선거에 나갈 계획이다.

options: (a): a substance that helps one feel lively
(b): the physical self that becomes tired from activity
(c): the state of feeling too awake
(d): the body part not influenced by blue light
questions.question:
밑줄 친 (a)~(d)가 가리키는 대상이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?

Be careful about caffeine.

Move your body actively.
Exercise during the day. Then, (b) your body will feel a little tired, and you will fall asleep easily at night. Remember to finish exercising a few hours before bedtime. If you finish (c) it right before bedtime, your body may feel too awake. You may not fall asleep easily.

Stop using your smartphone before bedtime.
If you use your smartphone late at night, (d) your brain will stay active. (e) The blue light from the phone will also tell your brain, "Hey, don't sleep yet." To sleep well, don't use your phone right before bedtime.
questions.explanation: (a)는 수면 문제를 일으키는 물질이므로 'helps one feel lively'가 아님. (b)는 올바름 - 신체가 활동으로 인해 피곤해짐. (c)는 운동을 잠자리 직전에 마치는 것을 의미하므로 올바름. (d)는 뇌(brain)이지 'body part not influenced by blue light'가 아님. 따라서 정답은 (b).
